patches.summary: Suppress syncResource NDJSON event stream under --json in workflow archive so stdout is a single parseable JSON document.
patches.reason: The generated syncResource emits NDJSON progress events to stdout (gated on !humanFriendly); combined with workflow archive's own summary JSON they made `workflow archive --json` unparseable, failing dogfood json_fidelity.
patches.validated_outcome: `workflow archive --json | jq .` parses; dogfood json_fidelity passes.

patches.summary: Bumped golang.org/x/net to v0.55.0 (from generator-pinned v0.43.0).
patches.reason: GO-2026-5026 is reachable via the generated cliutil/probe.go http3 path; govulncheck blocks publish on v0.43.0.

patches.summary: Hand-authored internal/store/indeed_ext.go adds Store.DeleteResource (deletes the resources row AND its resources_fts entry) and Store.ListAll (uncapped scan); used by untrack, saved delete, and company.
patches.reason: Raw `DELETE FROM resources` left orphaned FTS index rows; company's List("job", 5000) silently truncated. DeleteResource lives in package store so it can reuse the generated, unexported ftsRowID to keep delete/insert rowids consistent.
patches.validated_outcome: untrack/saved-delete remove FTS entries; go test ./internal/store/ passes.
